sloka: धर्मं प्राप्स्यसि धर्मज्ञ यशश्च विपुलं भुवि ।रामे प्रसन्ने स्वर्गं च महिमानं तथैव च ।। ६.१२२.२९ ।।
transliteration: dharmaṁ prāpsyasi dharmajña yaśaśca vipulaṁ bhuvi ।rāme prasanne svargaṁ ca mahimānaṁ tathaiva ca ।। 6.122.29 ।।

translations.english: "O knower of dharma! If Rama is pleased, extensive fame as well as heaven and supreme glory will be attained on this earth."
